thread:
jon (hw-partnerships): Quick ask — Zenith and Volt sent updated supply curves + reserve/spot splits. Finance needs clear bid bands and spot eviction assumptions by EOD so they can run cost scenarios. anyone on call for clarifying items?

maria (finance): Thanks — i have Zenith's sheet but some fields are ambiguous (is 'spot floor' net of marketplace fees?). main things we need: effective hourly price after listing fee, expected preempt rate by quarter, and commit window granularity (monthly vs quarterly).

casey (partnerships-lead): @jon @maria I pinged Zenith earlier today. quick recap from their product: they propose 3 buckets (reserved, burst-reserved, spot) with different SLAs. listing fee is 6% on marketplace price, applied post-discount. they gave example numbers but not the eviction curve.

supply-bot: Uploaded zenith_supply_2026.csv to shared drive: https://redwood.drive/zenith_supply_2026.csv :file_folder:

maria (finance): Copying example they sent — can we treat this as the canonical snippet?
```csv
bucket,commit_pct,capacity_units,price_usd_per_hour,listing_fee_pct,notes
reserved,0.60,1200,0.42,6,reserved 12mo
burst_reserved,0.05,100,0.55,6,burst capacity on demand
spot,0.35,900,0.10,6,ephemeral preemptible
```

jon (hw-partnerships): that matches. key unknown: spot preempt rate. zenith mentioned seasonal spikes — "up to 20%" in Q1 historically. we need an assumption: conservative = 20%, base = 10%, optimistic = 5%. which should finance use?

maria (finance): Run all three scenarios. base = 10% eviction, but please confirm if their "up to" is per-day or cumulative monthly. casey can you ask them to clarify the timescale?

casey (partnerships-lead): will do. also asking about commit split flexibility — can customers shift reserved to burst? Zenith said "limited swaps with 2-week notice". we need that in modeling as a leak factor. propose leak = 3% monthly for reserved to burst. thoughts?

sam (platform): For private/dedicated customers, latency tiers matter. If reserved capacity is in a different physical pool, pricing should reflect cross-pool egress if we fallback to spot. include a +$0.02/hr delta for cross-pool hops in the model.

maria (finance): noted. also need marketplace listing fees and platform take in the waterfall: gross price -> listing fee -> vendor payout -> our margin. example calc in comment form is helpful.

jon (hw-partnerships): here's a micro example to validate models:

- gross_market_price = $0.50/hr
- listing_fee = 6% => platform fee = $0.03
- vendor_spot_price = $0.10/hr -> vendor payout after fee ~= $0.094
- our gross margin = gross_market_price - vendor_payout - infra_delta (~$0.02) => $0.50 - 0.094 - 0.02 = $0.386/hr (before tax/overheads)

maria (finance): perfect, finance will incorporate that waterfall. please confirm whether vendors want price floors on spot when our margin drops below X. some partners request a minimum vendor revenue.

casey (partnerships-lead): Zenith wants a floor: vendor revenue per unit >= $0.08/hr on spot. that interacts with our dynamic routing fallback — if spot price + listing fee would push vendor below floor, they want us to route to burst_reserved or reserved with surcharge.

sam (platform): We can implement policy rules: if vendor_payout < floor then route to next tier. need test vectors and a small rollout plan. also check implications for SLAs and customer invoices.

jon (hw-partnerships): action items: 1) casey confirms eviction timescale + floor request in writing (ETA: 4pm PT). 2) maria runs three eviction scenarios with leak factors and cross-pool delta. 3) sam drafts routing policy prototype and test vector doc. i'll consolidate into a single CSV for modeling.

maria (finance): assigning myself to scenario runs, will push results to the cost-model repo by EOD.

casey (partnerships-lead): sending the clarification thread to Zenith now, CCing the vendor rep.

supply-bot: Zenith confirmation message uploaded: zenith_eviction_note.txt

jon (hw-partnerships): great — if any of you see red flags (e.g., vendor floors that make some marketplace SKUs unprofitable), flag in the thread and we'll escalate to PM + legal. otherwise finance will validate pricing sensitivity and we can sync with go-to-market for announcement timing. :white_check_mark:
